trailhead.label: Borgata Adret, San Giorio di Susa, the board’s start

cautions: A steep stretch at the start and a short steep climb after the refuge, on mountain paths (T2): take it slowly with an older dog.
In winter the board says snowshoes, microspikes and avalanche gear may be needed: walk it only when it is clear of snow and ice.
Inside the park dogs must stay on a lead.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.In winter the board says snowshoes, micr: D’inverno il sito indica che possono servire ciaspole, ramponcini e kit di autosoccorso in valanga: percorrilo solo senza neve e ghiaccio.
